description: Tests up to 10,000 points ([lon, lat] pairs) against one boundary and returns a boolean per point plus the inside count. Use it for geofencing, service-area checks and filtering customer lists. Costs 1 unit per 1,000 points. Needs an API key or a connected account.

id.description: Boundary id: r<OSM relation id> (e.g. r62422 for Berlin) or w<way id>. Also accepts R62422, relation/62422, -62422, an openstreetmap.org URL, wikidata:Q64 or iso:US-CA.

name: contains_points
title: Points in boundary
